name: ag-pdlc-kit
description: Ag-PDLC Kit — a documentation discipline for code repositories: four levels (AGENTS.md, PRODUCT.md, ADRs, specs), the skills that keep it alive, the skill that builds against them test-first, the skill that reviews the result before it is committed, and the skill that reports on it to readers outside the repository

plugins.name: ag-pdlc-kit
plugins.description: Installs and maintains a four-level documentation discipline on a repository, records a feature's decisions while they still exist, records the decisions that arrive without code, builds a spec into code and tests once it has a go-ahead, reviews a change against the repository's own conventions before it is committed, and reports what a project delivered and decided to readers outside the repository
